title: Print Manager

phoenix.//: Phoenix launcher metadata (docs/APP-RUNTIME.md): launcherTab 0 = Apps, 1 = Downloads, 2 = Settings. Print Manager was on the settings page of the webOS launcher (luna-sysmgr conf/default-launcher-page-layout.json, com.palm.app.printmanager); the print dialog launches it by that id, an alias of this one.

//requiredPermissions: OSE access control groups for the services the app calls (the groups in each service's sysbus api.json): com.palm.applicationManager/open for a saved PDF.
